theorem: On a valid N2 reference chart, floor(log2 b2)<=ell<=floor(log2 b3)-1 and s=2^ell*q>1/2 imply b3*q>=2*s>1. If b3*q>=2 retain N2. If 1<b3*q<2 and b4>=2*b3, use ell3=floor(log2 b3): then 1/2<2^ell3*q<2, ell3 is in the N3 source window, and b4*q>2.
limits: Both charts must use the same actual common family; actual image, frozen representative and compatibility/flat-seam theorem remain separate. Rational cases test the proof and do not evaluate actual source scales.
